summary: This is an 8-K filed by blank-check company Mercator Acquisition Corp. reporting the closing of its initial public offering. The company sold 17,250,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option, and completed a concurrent private placement of 4,500,000 warrants to the sponsor and underwriter at $1.00 each. Gross IPO proceeds totaled $172.5 million, of which $172.5 million (including the underwriter's deferred discount) was deposited into trust. The filing includes the audited balance sheet as of July 8, 2026. This is a routine IPO-related current report, not a special-situation event; the company is now a SPAC seeking a business combination.
